scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @lucky-break/core-domain lint && pnpm --filter @lucky-break/cli-sim lint && pnpm --filter @lucky-break/web-client lint
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --filter @lucky-break/core-domain lint:fix && pnpm --filter @lucky-break/cli-sim lint:fix && pnpm --filter @lucky-break/web-client lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @lucky-break/core-domain typecheck && pnpm --filter @lucky-break/cli-sim typecheck && pnpm --filter @lucky-break/web-client typecheck
scripts.ci: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm simulate:verify
